title: 第十一章 博九秦漠正式相遇3
slug: 国民校草是女生全本免费-国民校草是女生最新章节列表
content_zh:
英语老师眯了眯眼，觉得自己是被蒋飞杨这个学生给耍了。
博九那张帅气腾腾的脸，适时的表现出了呆呆的茫然。
英语老师见状，心头的火气更大了，转头对着蒋飞扬道：“你自己不好好听课就算了，还想让其他同学给你背黑锅？你现在就给我出来！“
蒋飞扬想不通他是怎么落到这个下场的，那个小弱渣明明是在打游戏，怎么抽手抽的就这么快。
而且……那明明就是秦少的游戏名字不是吗？
难道是他看错了？
送走碍事的人之后，博九才低头又把平板抽了出来。
让人皱眉的是，蒋飞扬刚刚那一声叫让她一个错手，竟然点了接受好友。
就在博九按着键盘要删人时，她像是察觉到了什么，黑色的瞳孔骤然一缩！
接着，便是似笑非笑的弧。
“没想到有一天也会有人会来猎捕我，有意思。”
博九一边说着，一边飞速的动着手指，平板上的页面刹那间就给变了。
没有了游戏，只有一串串的代码不断的从屏幕上涌动而出！
和博九的轻松不同，另外一边身形巨大的胖子，噼里啪啦的敲着手中的机械键盘，脸上都冒出了汗，最后嘭的一声整个人都趴在了那，狠狠的敲打了一下桌面：“姥姥的，被他跑了！”
“你说什么？跑了？”喵系少年摘掉了正在直播的耳机，扔下了百万粉丝，侧过头来，满脸的惊讶：“怎么可能在你的手里跑掉？你可是全国榜上有名的黑客，胖子，你别随便乱开玩笑，队长可在这儿呢。”
胖子抹了一把脸，眼睛都是亮的，那是遇到高手之后的兴奋，他没搭理喵系少年，转过头去对着秦漠激动的道：“秦总，你们是从哪遇到的这么一个人，太神了！就是反应有点慢，发现我发现的有点晚，不过他后来简直就像是开了外挂，成千上百个网络虚拟IP同时凿过来，把真实的数据完全的进行了掩盖，不仅仅如此，他居然还在擦掉痕迹的同时，朝着我这边植入了一个无法破解的病毒！厉害，太厉害！我猜他用的电脑配置应该不太好，不然的话，就算是我都攻破了不他的外围。“
“不是，胖子你先说说，我这电脑怎么回事，怎么黑屏了，啊？“喵系少年咬着兔子耳朵，完全听不懂他在说什么。
胖子喔了一声，言简意赅的解释了一句：“对方弄了一个病毒在你电脑里，我不会解。“
喵系少年嘴角抽了抽：“也就是说，你黑人家不成，反被对方攻击的坏了电脑？“
“可以这么说。”胖子摸了摸下巴，颇为深沉。

喵系少年：……那你还深沉个毛啊！被人反攻了很骄傲吗！
秦漠却视这些为无物，伸手将公司文件放下，修长的双腿微搭，下巴处勾勒出了一抹流畅的曲线：“说一说你攻破的外围。”
“嘿，还是秦总英明，会抓重点。”胖子一笑，非常狡猾：“我查出了他的大概位置，就在这所学校！”

content_en:
The English teacher squinted his eyes, feeling that he had been tricked by the student Jiang Feiyang.
Bo Jiu's handsome face showed a daze at the right time.
When the English teacher saw this, he became even more angry. He turned to Jiang Feiyang and said, "It's okay if you don't listen to the class well, but you still want other students to take the blame for you? Come out now!"
Jiang Feiyang couldn't figure out how he ended up like this. That little weakling was obviously playing a game, so why did he pull out his hand so fast?
And... that's obviously the name of Master Qin's game, isn't it?
Could it be that he saw it wrong?
After sending away the troublesome person, Bo Jiu lowered his head and pulled out the tablet again.
What makes people frown is that Jiang Feiyang's call just now caused her to make a mistake and click to accept friends.
Just when Bo Jiu was pressing the keyboard to delete the person, she seemed to notice something, and her black pupils suddenly shrank!
Then, there was an arc that looked like a smile but not a smile.
"I didn't expect that one day someone would come to hunt me. It's interesting."
As Bo Jiu spoke, he moved his fingers rapidly, and the page on the tablet changed instantly.
There is no game anymore, just strings of codes constantly pouring out of the screen!
Different from Bo Jiu's relaxation, the huge fat man on the other side was typing on the mechanical keyboard in his hand, with sweat breaking out on his face. Finally, with a bang, he fell down and hit the table hard: "Grandma, he ran away!"
"What did you say? He ran away?" The meow-type boy took off the headphones that were being broadcast live, threw away his millions of fans, turned his head, and said with surprise on his face: "How could he run away in your hands? You are a well-known hacker on the national list, fat man, don't make random jokes, the captain is here."
The fat man wiped his face, his eyes were bright, it was the excitement after meeting a master. He ignored the meow boy, turned to Qin Mo and said excitedly: "Mr. Qin, where did you meet such a person? It's amazing! It's just that the reaction was a bit slow, and I found it a little late, but later he was like a cheat, thousands of people Hundreds of network virtual IPs came over at the same time, completely covering up the real data. Not only that, but he also planted an unbreakable virus on me while erasing the traces! Amazing, amazing! I guess the computer configuration he used was not very good, otherwise, even I wouldn't have been able to break through his peripherals.
"No, fat man, please tell me first, what's going on with my computer? Why is the screen black?" The meow-type boy bit the rabbit's ear, not understanding what he was saying at all.
The fat man groaned and explained in a concise and concise manner: "The other party put a virus in your computer, and I don't know how to solve it."
The corner of the cat boy's mouth twitched: "In other words, you are not a black man, but you were attacked by the other party and broke your computer?"
"You can say that." The fat man touched his chin, quite deeply.
Meow-type boy: ...then you are so stupid! Are you proud of being counterattacked?
Qin Mo regarded these as nothing, reached out and put down the company documents, his slender legs were slightly crossed, and a smooth curve was outlined on his chin: "Tell me about the perimeter you broke through."
"Hey, Mr. Qin is still smart and knows how to grasp the key points." The fat man smiled and said very slyly: "I found out his approximate location, he is in this school!"
